long_biography.plain_text:
Natural stone was already the family trade when Ali Şayakçı entered business. He has described his father as both a miner and a builder of sailing boats. As general manager of Şayakçı Natural Stone, he shifted sales towards quarry blocks exported to China, rather than processing slabs and tiles. The family group remains active in stone and other natural resources.

Şayakçı also leads Evadne Yachts, an Istanbul shipyard that grew from yacht conversions into a series of metal explorer craft. He has worked with outside designers while directing the yard’s production and development. Trade reporting identifies him as its president, and a maritime training publication records the completion of another explorer model under his supervision.
